name: Software Technology Engineering
summary: Software development from scratch: programming, web development, software design, algorithms, DevOps and machine learning, organised as semester projects and a 20-week internship. You can then specialise in interactive media, business information systems or machine learning and AI. Needs Maths A, Physics B and English B.

family.name: Software Technology Engineering
family.differs: General software engineering; specialise later in interactive media, business systems or machine learning. Starts in September.
